items.description: Segment is the web application that lets users collect, manage and route their customer analytics data. This mashup uses the Pipl API.
Dutch National Heritage List in the Netherlands (rijksmonumenten). Many Dutch tourist attractions are rijksmonuments, such as castles or windmills. There are 61.000 rijksmonuments in the Netherlands.
Great for runners, hikers, bicyclist and anyone else interested in how far they ran, walked, biked, or traveled. Map, save, find, and share your routes.
Twitter realtime feed. iGoogle style drag and drop with Twitter power search. Search current daily and weekly trends. Search TwitPics and audio.

Boost is a mobile application that enables users to pre-order their drinks online to pick up at the Boost juice store or have it delivered to them (depending on location). Boost uses MYOB AccountRight Live API, which allows customers to interact with Boost individually.
YouTubeMP4 creates a link to the mpeg4 file on YouTube from the YouTube URL. You can download the file quickly by directly downloading it from YouTube.
Find babysitters, nannies, and other care options visually with Google Maps.
Slick custom interface on Virtual Earth map to search for real estate in Australia with user-defined property criteria and location.
Instantly create mashups between two different Youtube videos.
Topix includes deals and daily deals on their map portion of their page. All deals sourced by 8coupons.
A mobile phone app for finding real-time bus arrivals for Madison Metro (Madison, WI). Just text your specific request to receive real-time arrival estimates.
